revisions.reason: Opt-in synchronous frame trace only: at most 256 frames per host with first8/last8 scalar progress samples, request IDs held weakly, branch and yield counts, endpoint generation/frame/wait epochs and outcome. No guest read/command, callback admission, scheduling, wait, resume, abort, limit, receiver/result/error or ownership semantics changed. Sink exceptions isolated and copied scalar data only. Real Worker/local nested completion/failure and stale/blocked/unarmed controls pass. General ownership remains pending. Run 20261118-aow2-send-callback-frame-cause.
